name: Evo Tycoon
desc:
Evo Tycoon. In this game you start from The Stone age and try to upgrade.

- Unlock generators and earn cash
- Unlock unique weapons and fight people
- Each floor is a different age (Total 7 floor)
- Your progress saves!
- Private servers are free!
- Have fun


This game is new so expect bugs.
Tags: Defense, War, Future, Apocalypse, Military, Tech, Ancient, Dinosaur, Fight, Battle, Combat, Weapon, Survive, Warfare, Power, Nuclear, Nuke
